title: Stephen Jones on George Pickens: We couldn't take a chance on losing him

sources.title: Stephen Jones on George Pickens: We couldn't take a chance on losing him
sources.description: The Cowboys officially placed the non-exclusive franchise tag on wide receiver George Pickens, which will carry a salary of $27.298 million for the 2026 season.
